method: Image-tool pigment with low-opacity glow removed, composited only onto previously bare rock.
visual_review: Viewed complete PNG and 512-pixel JPEG: recognizable Pepe, earth pigments, no text or prohibited marks; all ancestors remain. The new head has no hands or handprints. Inherited hands were left untouched; five digits are visible on the extended hand, while the gripping hand is partly curled.
limitations: New charcoal face is subdued at thumbnail size. The curled inherited grip does not expose all digits equally clearly; no ancestor was altered.
